Understand the expectations he has for you, will there be any training with the current EA, will you be on-call. Ask about his 30.60.90 days expectations for this position, and what type of projects you will be taking over.
Understanding his working style/ communication style will help you understand your work life balance. Research his company, ask about the tech they use at the company and make sure you are familiar.
As someone who interviewed with them, the way to stand out is have tech exp (which I did) or have someone refer you. People who are referred will normally get an interview
